name: Omni by xpander
description: Takes a locally built agent to production cloud — wires up its tools and skills, tests it against mock data, then returns it as a scheduled long-running cloud agent.

skills.name: Tool Wiring
skills.description: Connects an agent to the tools and skills it needs in production, resolving credentials and integration wiring.

skills.name: Mock Data Testing
skills.description: Exercises an agent against generated mock data before deployment to surface failures ahead of real traffic.

skills.name: Scheduled Runs
skills.description: Runs deployed agents on a schedule as long-lived cloud workers with managed state and restart handling.
